Project Name: NetPulse AI – Smart Signal Strength Prediction
Problem Identification: Predict cellular signal strength (dBm) using network telemetry and location to support planning and optimization.
Data Issues / EDA: Missing values in device/radio measurements; mixed categorical levels for Network Type; outliers in dBm; numeric ranges validated for latitude/longitude; duplicates removed; schema verified against SQLite table.
ML Model Features: locality; latitude; longitude; network_type; throughput_mbps; latency_ms; signal_quality_pct; bb60c_dbm; srsran_dbm; bladerf_dbm
Results: Best Model: Ridge-v1 | R2=0.8933 | MAE=1.2167 dBm | RMSE=1.7363 dBm | Rows Trained=13463 | Last Trained=UTC timestamp stored in meta.json
Business Impact: Accelerates coverage planning and QoS monitoring; provides explainable KPIs (R²/MAE/RMSE); enables real-time what-if predictions through a simple web UI and REST APIs; reduces field measurement cycles and supports data-driven rollout decisions.
